shortDescription: Canada's main stock index opened higher on Thursday, boosted by gains in mining stocks that tracked rising prices of metals, while investors assessed prospects of interest rate hikes and elevated bond yields.The S&P/TSX Composite Index TSX:TSX was up 0.8% at 36,383.25 at 09:30 a.m. ET.
